verdict.justification: Both deliverables are thorough, well-organized, and properly follow the instructions to exclude the CFO-reserved tabs (1, 2, 2a, and 3), update Tabs 3a onward with April data, add the three new April accrual schedules at the end of the workbook, and flag accounting discrepancies for the CFO. Deliverable A edges out Deliverable B due to cleaner source-file mapping on the Table of Contents and stronger review documentation. Specifically, Deliverable A correctly maps Aurisic_Prepaid_Expenses_4-25-1.xlsx (which covers Account #1250) exclusively to Tab 7 (PPD Expenses #1250), whereas Deliverable B erroneously cites it as a duplicate source on Tab 8 (PPD Insurance #1251) as well. Deliverable A also preserves the exact 1-to-15 numbering alignment on Tab 0 from the March template and includes a dedicated Schedule-to-GL Tie-Out summary tab (Tab 19) in addition to the Open Items and Change Log tabs.
